what.question: What is Global Pulse?
what.answer: Global Pulse is a planetary intelligence platform that monitors global events, analyzes risk, and delivers AI-powered briefings — helping teams understand a changing world in real time.

data.question: Where does the data come from?
data.answer: We aggregate open and configured intelligence providers including USGS, NASA EONET, ACLED, GNews, weather APIs, and more. All data is normalized through our Intelligence Engine.

free.question: Is Global Pulse free to use?
free.answer: The Community tier is free for exploration, research, and competition use. Mission Control, alerts, and AI are available now on Community. Professional and Enterprise plans will add billing, SSO, and advanced options in a future update.

keys.question: Do I need API keys?
keys.answer: Some providers work out of the box. Optional keys (Mapbox, Gemini, Supabase) unlock the full experience including the 3D globe, AI chat, and saved reports.

presentations.question: Can I use it for presentations?
presentations.answer: Yes. Mission Control is designed as a flagship presentation mode with a cinematic dark interface optimized for demos and live monitoring.

different.question: How is this different from a news aggregator?
different.answer: Global Pulse correlates events, scores risk, maps entity relationships, and generates decision support — it is an intelligence platform, not a headline feed.

what.title: What is Global Pulse?
what.body: An educational Planetary Intelligence platform that aggregates public global data — news, earthquakes, weather, alerts, and country indicators — into one polished interface with LIVE / CACHED / DEMO labels.

problem.title: The problem it solves
problem.body: Public data exists across many fragmented APIs. Global Pulse shows how a thoughtful UI can turn raw feeds into glanceable, transparent insight for learning and demos.

users.title: Target users
users.body: Students, educators, hobbyists in geopolitics, climate or seismology, and anyone curious about live world data.

tech.title: Technologies used
tech.body: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Start / Router / Query, Tailwind CSS, Mapbox GL, Recharts, XYFlow, Radix UI, Framer Motion, Nitro, Vercel, Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + RLS).

apis.title: APIs used
apis.body: GNews, USGS, OpenWeather, REST Countries, Mapbox, Google Gemini, ACLED, NASA FIRMS, GDACS, GDELT, ReliefWeb, RSS — accessed via server proxies so keys stay off the client.

supabase.title: Supabase integration
supabase.body: Auth (email, Google, GitHub) and per-user persistence: collections, saved articles, reading history, watchlists, preferences. Row Level Security isolates data with user_id = auth.uid(). Schema lives in supabase/migrations/.

map.title: Why the map matters
map.body: A Mapbox GL globe gives spatial context to seismic, intelligence, and alert data — a core pattern of modern monitoring dashboards.

education.title: Educational value
education.body: Demonstrates async data fetching, error/loading/empty states, charting, geospatial visualization, SSR/API routes, AI grounding, and database CRUD with RLS — common topics in modern web courses.

future.title: Future improvements
future.body: Richer real-time push notifications, satellite imagery overlays, forecast charts, and deeper multi-source correlation explanations.

limits.title: Data limitations
limits.body: Free public APIs may rate-limit or lag; demo data is clearly labeled. This is not an operational intelligence tool.

privacy.title: Privacy and ethics
privacy.body: Cloud saves require sign-in. Feedback is optional. Personal workspace data is isolated per user via RLS. Guests can browse public dashboards without an account.

how.title: How Intelligence Reports work
how.dataIntro: Reports are generated from the centralized Intelligence Store, which spans every active provider — not just headlines:
how.dataAcled: ACLED conflict events & NASA FIRMS fire detections (where configured)
how.dataHealth: API health / data status labels (LIVE, CACHED, DEMO)
how.genBody: Global Pulse builds a structured draft from in-app data, then optionally polishes it with Global Pulse AI (Google Gemini) when configured. If Gemini is busy or unavailable, a local structured fallback is used — still based only on loaded data.
how.limitInvent: Reports never invent headlines, magnitudes, or countries.
how.limitDemo: DEMO data is clearly labeled and must not be treated as live breaking news.
how.limitCached: CACHED data reflects previously fetched live headlines, not the open internet.
how.limitRisk: Risk scores are educational composites, not official assessments.
